with_money.name: With money
with_money.low: I hold on to every coin

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.low: I wait for things to come to me
initiative.high: I get up, get on with it and find a way

seeks_company.name: Seeks company
seeks_company.high: I seek people out, and at the extreme can't bear to be left

takes_charge.name: Takes charge
takes_charge.low: I go along with others and do as I'm asked
takes_charge.high: I tell others what to do and ask for what I want

kindness.name: Kindness
kindness.low: Other people's trouble doesn't move me
kindness.high: I help whoever is in trouble

trust.name: Trust
trust.high: I take people at their word

honesty.name: Honesty
honesty.low: I lie when it suits me

uses_people.name: Uses people
uses_people.high: I charm or steer people to get what I want

wants_to_be_seen.name: Wants to be seen
wants_to_be_seen.low: I'm content to go unnoticed and give others the credit
wants_to_be_seen.high: I need to be looked at and owed the credit

follow_through.name: Follow-through
follow_through.low: I drop goals and get sidetracked
follow_through.high: I stick with a goal until it's done, and at the extreme keep trying what fails

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.low: I break promises and forget what I owe
reliability.high: I keep my word and pay what I owe

orderliness.name: Orderliness
orderliness.high: I keep count and keep things in order

risk_taking.name: Risk-taking
risk_taking.low: I'm fearful and keep out of danger
risk_taking.high: I go toward danger for the thrill or the prize

temper.name: Temper
temper.high: I flare up quickly and my moods swing

bounces_back.name: Bounces back
bounces_back.low: I get discouraged and give up

curiosity.name: Curiosity about the world
curiosity.low: I don't care how things work
curiosity.high: I can't leave a question alone

taste_for_beauty.name: Taste for beauty
taste_for_beauty.low: I don't care how things look
taste_for_beauty.high: Fine and beautiful things move me

imagination.name: Imagination
imagination.low: I'm practical and do things the usual way
imagination.high: I'm inventive, and odd at the extreme

use.name: Use
use.high: I make use of whatever I have on me

build.name: Build
build.low: I make do with what I have
build.high: I'd sooner have a thing made or built for me

influence.name: Influence
influence.low: I do things myself rather than ask
influence.high: I get others to act for me or with me

investigate.name: Investigate
investigate.low: I take things as they look
investigate.high: I look closer, ask questions, follow a lead

convince.name: Convince
convince.low: I let people think what they like
convince.high: I talk people round to my way of seeing it

trade.name: Buy, sell, trade
trade.low: I'd rather not deal in money or swaps
trade.high: I'm always buying, selling or swapping

stay_silent.name: Stay silent
stay_silent.low: I say what I'm doing as I do it
stay_silent.high: I keep my own counsel and act without a word

go.name: Go somewhere
go.high: I'm off to see the next place

work.name: Work for pay
work.low: I'd rather not work for wages
work.high: I'll take any paid work going

give.name: Give and help
give.low: I keep what's mine for myself
give.high: I give things away and lend a hand

grab.name: Grab
grab.low: I'd never take what someone holds
grab.high: If someone holds what I need, I take it

fight.name: Fight
fight.high: I'll fight for what I want

wait.name: Wait
wait.low: I can't let a moment pass idle
wait.high: I'm content to wait and see
